title: IC-U-Net
subtitle: Deployment

overview.title: Artifact in input units
overview.description: Centre selection, optional DC removal and rescaling

nodes.title: Deployment input normalisation
description: Demean across configured axes; optionally divide by input standard deviation.
Packing and context axis come from the run configuration.

nodes.title: ICA projection
description: Apply frozen ICA matrix W after configured input demeaning.

nodes.title: Component U-Net encoder
description: Double Conv1d / BatchNorm / LeakyReLU; three max-pool down stages.

nodes.title: Component U-Net decoder
description: Upsampling, concatenate matching skips, double convolutions.
Identity initialisation adds input components to the U-Net correction when enabled.

nodes.title: Inverse ICA
description: Apply pseudoinverse W+; select centre epoch.

nodes.title: Centre artifact
description: Noisy centre minus reconstructed clean centre.

nodes.title: Deployment artifact output
description: Convert the configured core output to a centre artifact.
Optionally remove prediction DC; restore the input scale.

edges.label: Deployment input normalisation to Multichannel context
ICA projection to Component U-Net encoder
Component U-Net encoder to Component U-Net decoder
Component U-Net decoder to Inverse ICA
Centre artifact to Deployment artifact output

notes: Deployment changes normalisation and objective; architecture parameters remain configuration-dependent.
Identity initialisation optionally adds the original ICA components before inverse projection.
Dimensions and repeated-block counts are configurable; consult the linked implementation and run configuration.
